notes:
Summary: Elmbridge builds an in-app product analytics assistant (query & doc search + guided insights). Completed 3-week Hosted API trial (January-Feb) focused on prototypes in support chat and search. Team liked latency and quality but wants clearer unit economics at scale. Quote from Head of Product: 'Hosted trial great for dev. Need predictable costs and guaranteed throughput for launch.'

POC highlights: dev team integrated chat + embeddings. Ran ~12 QPS sustained during business hours, spikes to ~36 QPS during foundation reports. Avg token per response ~50; token mix skewed to short replies. Found memory-based reranking helps reduce long-context calls.

Why Dedicated: need deterministic throughput (SLO 150ms P95 for short responses), VPC peering for event delivery, and audit logs for compliance. Also want option to pin model versions during rollout.

Commercials: evaluating 12–24 month reserved capacity; primary ask is pricing sheet for 2 capacity sizes (standard and launch peak). Concerned about cost of burst capacity and storage of cached KV stores.

Operational asks: simple autoscale rules (baseline + scheduled business-hour bump + emergency fallback), token-level cost dashboard, and SOC2 evidence for procurement. Legal flagged data residency clause for EU customers.

Quote/snippets: 'If we can map peak-hour token costs to a forecasted ARR bucket we can budget for Q3 launch.'

dedicated_capacity_request: Request details from product: baseline sustained 12 QPS (daytime 9am-6pm), baseline concurrency ~48 in-flight sessions, avg 50 tokens/response. Token mix estimated: 70% short (<=32 tokens), 25% medium (33-256), 5% long (>256). Peak day pattern: 2-hour peak at 36 QPS sustained; micro-bursts up to 120 QPS for <60s due to dashboard generation. Initial Dedicated ask: 2 x 80GB-GPU equivalent (reserved), 1x warm spare for failover + autoscale to 4x for short bursts. Want autoscale policy that favors warm warmup to keep P95 <200ms. Also request persistent KV-cache disk attachment for prefix caching and snapshot backups for quick warm restarts.
traffic_forecast: Quarterly forecast (conservative): Q2 users 18k MAU -> 400k LLM requests/month; avg tokens/request 80 -> 32M tokens/month. Peak hour: 36 QPS sustained -> ~2.6M tokens/hour (peak). Cost target: < $0.015 per 1k tokens (platform cost) to meet their target gross margins. Ops SLA: P95 latency target 150ms for short prompts, <400ms for medium. Forecast rationale: conversion of analytics queries + support escalations, 2x YOY growth assumed for sizing over contract term.
additional_notes_for_sales: Sales asks: produce 2 pricing options (standard reserved + launch peak-reserve) and a clear explanation of burst billing. Create a sample SOW template with residency addendum and SOC2 attestation. Recommend offering a 3-month performance review (metrics: P95 latency, token consumption, cache hit rate).
win_likelihood_commentary: Engaged, technical buyer with clear runway and internal budget. Hosted trial was positive. Main friction: legal residency + burst pricing clarity. If pricing for reserved burst is reasonable and SLOs documented, high chance to convert (60-75%).
